marketplace/checkout-page/blocked-addres.failure_signature: expect(locator).toContainText failed; Locator: getByTestId('ernie-message').and(locator(':visible')); Error: element(s) not found; Timeout 60000ms exceeded while waiting on the predicate at base-page.ts:53

attempts.hypothesis: expectErnieWithMessage() (base-page.ts, 39 call sites) reads ernie-message from a page-wide locator independent of the container it just confirmed visible, so a container-visible/message-not-found race on this test's one-shot success toast times out the 60s toPass before the toast fully settles.
attempts.fix_applied: Attempted: scope the message check to the same top-most :visible ernie container already used for the type read (topErnie.getByTestId('ernie-message')) instead of a page-wide getByTestId('ernie-message').and(':visible') query.
attempts.result: Fix made [800122] pass in isolation (confirmed via real trace evidence matching the hypothesis exactly), but broke the already-passing sibling [800121] (QA-980/PR #21899's fix) when the full spec file was re-run: topErnie's 'last visible container' selection resolved to a node with an empty ernie-message in 800121's dismiss-then-recheck flow. Reverted rather than ship a fix that regresses a sibling on a 39-call-site shared helper. Needs human review of the helper's ernie-selection strategy before a 2nd attempt.
